card.name: Middle digit of 1,200-style numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, usually the 0 in the middle of a comma-separated number like 1,2<<0>>0, written before mg. It also fires on a digit inside other numbers such as 2,2<<9>>2.

modes.label: Digit in 1,200 doses
modes.description: The middle 0 of 1,200 just before a dose unit such as mg or mg/kg.

modes.label: Digit in other counts
modes.description: A digit inside a comma-grouped count in general text, such as a household number.
modes.example: There were 2,2<<9>>2 households out of which 36
